messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 3512345678 - container crashloop detected in prod/gpu-pool-3. crashloopCount > 5 for runtime-engine (v2.1.4) on nodes gpu-03,gpu-05. Observed uptick in 502/503s from API gateway. Auto-scale attempted.
Maria (oncall): I'm on it. any immediate customer-facing impact known?
Raj (eng-sre): seeing ~15% 5xx across /v1/generate for a few customers, spikes correlate with requests routed to gpu-pool-3. Cluster shows repeated OOMs and CUDA watchdog resets. Logs show segfault in engine native kernel.
Emma (eng-runtime): copying relevant excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] runtime-engine[v2.1.4]: EV: allocate_kv_cache failed: cudaErrorLaunchTimeout
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] runtime-engine[v2.1.4]: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7ffeffff, pc=0x55a3b2a1
stack: runtime/core.c:421 -> kernels/custom_attention.cu:112 -> trt_executor.cu:78
```
Emma (eng-runtime): repro on a local repro node yields immediate segfault when sequence length spikes > 2048 with fused kernel enabled. Hypothesis: certain batch/seq combos trigger kernel hang -> watchdog reset -> segfault on next invocation.
Alan (infra): gpu-03 and gpu-05 show kernel timeouts in dmesg and nvidia-smi shows GPU process restart. Nodes are flapping MRT (driver-level) but not full host reboots.
Maria (oncall): are there recent rollout/deploys to runtime-engine? any config changes? Julia (product) — FYI customers A and B reported degraded responses earlier.
Emma (eng-runtime): No code deploys in last 6 hours. We rotated a model quantization profile yesterday but that should be orthogonal; though it changed kernel selection path in runtime binary.
Raj (eng-sre): immediate mitigations to reduce customer impact:
- scale down requests to gpu-pool-3 via routing policy (route ~70% to gpu-pool-1/2)
- disable fused/custom kernels temporarily (runtime flag) and restart pods
- cordon gpu-03 and gpu-05 to stop scheduling new pods until further triage
I'm going to run the commands now.
Raj (eng-sre): running:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/runtime-engine KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/runtime-engine -l pool=gpu-pool-3
kubectl cordon gpu-03 gpu-05
```
Raj (eng-sre): rolled env, restarted pods. new pods are launching with KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 (will use conservative kernels / CPU fallback for fused parts). Monitoring.
Maria (oncall): routing change applied? we need to avoid cascading. @emma can you confirm model variants compatible with fallback?
Emma (eng-runtime): confirmed — fallback binary path supports the pinned model variants; throughput will drop ~20-30% but latency should stabilize. We also have a CPU-only fallback for tail requests if needed.
Customer Ops: Customer A reports <10% request failures now, previously ~40%. They asked for ETA.
Raj (eng-sre): initial impact window: ~10:12 - ongoing. After mitigations, failures dropped to ~6% of baseline. Rolling restarts succeeded; no more immediate segfaults on restarted pods in gpu-pool-3.
Alan (infra): nodes remain cordoned. nvcrd logs show watchdog timeout events at 10:11:xx and 10:12:xx. Driver version 525.85.05. I'll open a ticket with cloud provider GPU infra team to check hardware-level ECC and driver telemetry.
Emma (eng-runtime): adding debug flags to capture kernel inputs for failing batches. Will push a debug image to a canary pod in gpu-pool-1 with telemetry enabled.
Raj (eng-sre): action items (short):
- keep KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 until we have a safe kernel patch (Emma)
- collect crash dumps and core files from affected pods (Raj/Alan)
- notify top-tier customers via Customer Ops with current mitigations and ETA (Maria/Julia)
- assign postmortem owner (Julia suggested Emma)
Maria (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 30m. @Raj please keep runbook updated and escalate to L3 if segfaults recur.
Emma (eng-runtime): will take postmortem lead. initial root cause hypothesis: fused/custom kernel path regressed under certain seq/batch distribution causing GPU kernel hang -> cuda watchdog timeout -> process SIGSEGV on recovery. Next steps: repro, create minimal test-case, patch kernel or force different kernel selection logic.
Customer Ops: please add affected customer ids: cust-231, cust-998, cust-421. Impact severity: P2 (degraded service), possible SLA exposures if sustained.
Raj (eng-sre): metric notes: token throughput on gpu-pool-3 fell 45% during restarts; p95 latency increased from 180ms to 420ms for routed fallback. Error budget burn rate increased x3.
Maria (oncall): handoff: I'm paging night-oncall (NOC) and tagging this as ongoing. Next oncall: Sam is up at 22:00 UTC, but current emergency -> please ack. @Alan retain cordon and don't uncordon until triage complete.
Emma (eng-runtime): I'll post a debug image with symbols to s3://redwood-debug/3512345678/ and upload core logs. Will also run a small synthetic to try reproduce sequence > 2048 but with pinned batch shapes.
Julia (product): drafting a short customer-facing note. ETA for a full fix TBD, but we'll aim for a revert/patch tomorrow AM followed by controlled canary.
Maria (oncall): summary for handoff: incident id 3512345678. Root symptoms: container crashloops due to runtime-engine segfault triggered by CUDA watchdog resets on fused kernel path. Impact: partial request failures for some customers; mitigated by kernel fallback + routing. Current status: mitigations in place, monitoring healthy, collecting artifacts. Owner: Emma (postmortem). Next steps: reproduce, patch, test on canary, uncordon after clean health across nodes. Primary slack thread maintained here. :white_check_mark:
Emma (eng-runtime): adding one more thing — generated a mini stacktrace to s3 and put the core dump link in the runbook. link: https://s3.redwood/internal/debug/3512345678/core.tar.gz
Raj (eng-sre): logging final steps before handoff: saved pod logs, set PagerDuty suppression for 10 minutes while we stabilize, created JIRA INC-3512345678 to track remediation.
Customer Ops: acknowledged. will escalate to customers if error rate rises above 10% again.
Maria (oncall): handing over to night team. If any recreations or new crashloops appear, wake me immediately. Good job everyone.
